tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// lcam dral gyi gtor chog bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod gtor byed par 'dod pas/ sha la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtor ma legs par bshams nas/ rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas gtor ma mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan par gyur par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan nas hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcad/ slar tshur 'dus nas/ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gaṇ+ḍī bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/

de'i g.yon du trag las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can du bsam/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcugs nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de nas mgon po dang lha mo gnyis ka'i dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas 'og min na rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ mgon po 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī/ e h+ye hi zhes brjod pas mdun du sbyan drang*/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes pas ye shes kyi mgon po dam tshig gi mgon po la bstim/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi lha mo dam tshig gi lha mo la bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la s+t+waṃ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i gdan 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas rnams so so la 'bul/ de nas chos skyong gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes pa dang*/ lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya byas la/ ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes brjod nas thun mong du dam tshig gi dbang gis dam tshig gi rim pa las mi 'da' bar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo dam tshig srungs shig rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing rgyas par byed pa dang*/ bdag cag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du brlag pa dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig ces dam la bzhag go /de nas dpal mgon po dang*/ lha mo gnyis kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+ya bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā zhes pa gsum mam lan bdun gyis mgon po la 'bul/

ā+oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa gsum mam bdun gyis lha mo la dbul lo// de nas/ hūm̐ srin po'i gzungags kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do// zhes pas bstod do// hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā ya// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che// ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can// tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā lā ya// 'jigs byed chen po ma hā kā lā ya// legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra// bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che// chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che// dam tshig can gyi dgra bla nag po che// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo sman dang phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyen por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyen por bzhes// 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes pas chos skyong la gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol lo// de nas lha mo la bstod pa bya ste/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ba// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces pas bstod nas/

dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces pa la sogs pas gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol lo// de nas/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā dang*// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces pa la sogs pas 'khor rnams la gtor ma bstabs/ phrin las gzhol/ de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas chos skyong gi thugs bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsī ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇāṃ/ ya di pra tidzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i gzungs kyi sngags ci nus par bzla'o// de bzhin du lha mo'i thugs bskul bar bsams la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭhā badh+wat+si ka ma la rāk+ṣa sī hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus bzla'o// de nas sngar bzhin du me tog la sogs pas mchod cing gang shes pas bstod la/ gsol ba btab nas bzod par gsol te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la badz+ra muḥm hā kā lī de wī badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos so// de nas chos skyong gi gzungs ring bzlas shing gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la gtang ngo*// tshul 'dis rtag tu gtor ma btang na/

byang chub thob kyi bar du srung ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa 'joms par 'gyur ro// dpal nag po chen po lcam dral gyi gtor ma'i cho ga bla ma'i phyag len bzhin 'phags pas bris nas jim gyin la phul ba'o// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ bla ma brag steng pa/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa yab sras rnams so// ma tshang med cing bsgrub par sla ba yi// cho ga'i rim pa 'di ni bdag gis bsdebs// spros la dga' bas rgyas pa gzhan du btsal// 'di tsam gyis kyang skabs kyi don 'grub 'gyur/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
